scope: Local implementation/testing only; no purchased infrastructure or public deployment.
limitations: Runs are diagnostic iterations, not an unchanged paired experiment or benchmark-lane comparison.
All failed workflow attempts remain included; no ready/exported revision in these three runs.
Latest one-case run predeclared zero optional visual-repair passes; required reviews/publication gates were not skipped.
The final dataset was regenerated after an authored oracle table keyboard-access defect was fixed; the prior dataset and failed instrument run are retained privately.
Model-produced Visual Spec is submitted automatically without human confirmation. Studio acceptance is not independent visual fidelity.
Source hashes cover raw workspace bytes and may differ from Git blobs after Windows line-ending normalization. Parent commit is not the tested patch commit.
Telemetry costs/tokens are provider observations with coverage counts; missing accounting is null, not zero. Infrastructure cost is excluded.
Candidate metrics are deterministic diagnostics before subsequent model reviews, not accepted-output quality scores.
Authored small samples, dynamic free routes and congestion do not establish generalization, causal speed or reliability. Six holdout quality cases remain unevaluated.
Public metadata omits private ownership/project/job IDs, paths, screenshots, source, prompts, raw errors and credentials. Raw evidence remains local and ignored by Git.
Traceable local evidence is not signed, immutable or tamper-proof.
